example: Hook is category-agnostic and uncertain (founder): a buyer asks AI about YOUR category, it could be anything; the answer may be you or your competitor, and you do not know. hyperank comes in and shows you. Worked example from s08: Lumen (lumenhq.com, fictional project management SaaS) vs the real incumbents Asana, monday.com, ClickUp in an 'Illustrative' answer. Voice says 'your product', 'buyer', 'client'.
device: INTERACTIVE QUESTIONS: each act opens with a question to the viewer typed into the same glass chat composer (blinking cursor, letter by letter), then the voice answers it. The composer is the film's recurring object, along with the AI answer card it produces.
